description: Fill in the checkout of the order in one call: invoice_address (an object: name, address, zipcode, city, country as a two-letter code, phone; state, companynr and vatnr when known), shipping_address when delivery goes elsewhere (or same_as_invoice), invoice_address_id or shipping_address_id from view_checkout when the shopper has saved addresses, shipping_method (an id from view_checkout), payment_method (a key from view_checkout), coupon, coupon_remove, newsletter (only when the shopper asks for it). Field errors name the field and how to fix it; postcodes follow the country's own format. Needs the order reference from start_order (Authorization: Bearer mo1_… or the ref argument). Send a fresh op_id (16 to 40 letters, digits, - or _) with each change: a repeat with the same op_id within 10 minutes answers the first result and never changes the order twice.

coupon.description: A discount code the shopper gave

invoice_address.description: The invoice address, stored on this order only

companynr.description: Chamber of commerce number, when known

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1), e.g. NL, DE, FR

state.description: Province or state, where the country has them

zipcode.description: Postcode in the format of the country

invoice_address_id.description: A saved address id from view_checkout (shoppers with an account)

newsletter.description: Only when the shopper asks for it

op_id.description: A fresh id per change (16 to 40 letters, digits, - or _); repeating it within 10 minutes answers the first result without changing the order again

ref.description: Order reference (mo1_…) from start_order, only when the client cannot send it as Authorization: Bearer

shipping_address.description: The delivery address when it differs from the invoice address

companynr.description: Chamber of commerce number, when known

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1), e.g. NL, DE, FR

state.description: Province or state, where the country has them

zipcode.description: Postcode in the format of the country

shipping_address_id.description: A saved address id, 0 = deliver to the invoice address

name: set_checkout
title: Set checkout
